title: auto-close

setup.note: The card goes up and the user does nothing. At 60 s it closes itself; the unread counter carries it and the work is still in the panel, on the shelf, in its space and on the timeline. A glance is the most a card can cost.

items.intent: comparing villas in Anjuna for 18-21 Dec

input_events: One artifact ready, the user at the Mac.
Sixty seconds pass with no tap.

expected.note: Closing loses nothing and the artifact never pops a second time.

wrong.label: lost-on-close
wrong.assert_absent: an artifact that is gone from the panel or the shelf after its card closed

wrong.label: re-pop
wrong.assert_absent: the same artifact showing a second card after it auto-closed
